```{r library, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(imager)
# generate data
library(mvtnorm)
# Clustering Algorithm
library(e1071)
library(mclust)
# CVI
library(UniversalCVI)
library(BayesCVI)
```

```{r data for clustering, echo=TRUE}

help(package = "UniversalCVI")
d1 = D1_data

ggplot(d1,aes(x,y))+
  geom_point(size=2,shape = 16,col=d1$label) +
  ggtitle("6 groups")

d2 = R1_data
d2plot = ggplot(d2,aes(x,y))+
  geom_point(size=2,shape = 16,col=d2$label)+
  ggtitle("9 groups or 3 groups")
d2plot

d3 = R7_data
ggplot(d3,aes(x,y))+
  geom_point(size=2,shape = 16,col=d3$label)+
  ggtitle("3 groups or 9 groups")


```


```{r check algorithm,echo = TRUE}
# Method1: using function AccClust in UniversalCVI

?AccClust

d1 %>% head()

AccClust(d1, label.names = "label",algorithm = c("Kmeans","FCM","EM"), fzm = 2,
  scale = TRUE, nstart = 20,iter = 100)

AccClust(d2, label.names = "label",algorithm = c("Kmeans","FCM","EM"), fzm = 2,
  scale = TRUE, nstart = 20,iter = 100)

AccClust(d3, label.names = "label",algorithm = c("Kmeans","FCM","EM"), fzm = 2,
  scale = TRUE, nstart = 20,iter = 100)


# Method2: Using plot 
dat.check = d2

colnames(dat.check) = c("x","y","label")
n.clust= length(unique(dat.check[,3]))

# Using kmeans
?kmeans
kmean_check = kmeans(dat.check[,-3],centers = n.clust, iter.max = 100, nstart = 100)

re.clust = kmean_check$cluster
re.cen = kmean_check$centers
cplot = ggplot(data.frame(dat.check),aes(x,y))+
  geom_point(size=2,shape = 16,col=re.clust)+
  geom_point(size = 2,shape = 19,data = as.data.frame(re.cen), aes(x = x, y = y), color = "yellow")+
  ggtitle("Result from clustering with k = 9")

ggarrange(d2plot,cplot)


cure = read.csv("cure-t0-2000n-2D.csv",header = FALSE)
cure %>% head()
hc.single=hclust(dist(cure[,-3]), method="complete")
sing3 = cutree(hc.single, 3)
sing3

ggplot(data.frame(cure),aes(V1,V2))+
  geom_point(size=2,shape = 16,col=sing3)+
  ggtitle("Result from clustering with k = 3")





```


```{r select number of cluster, echo = TRUE}

# Use cluster validity index from function UniversalCVI

d2plot
d2 %>% head(2)
plot(scale(d2[,-3]))

help(package = UniversalCVI)

?Hvalid

re.cvi = Hvalid(scale(d2[,-3]), kmax = 15, kmin = 2, indexlist = c("NCI", "DI", "DB", "DBs", "CSL", "CH"), method = "kmeans", p = 2, q = 2, corr = "pearson", nstart = 100, NCstart = TRUE)
re.cvi
plot_idx(re.cvi)
d2plot

plot(R4_data[,-3])

re.cvi = Hvalid(scale(R4_data[,-3]), kmax = 10, kmin = 2, indexlist = c("NCI", "DI", "DB", "DBs", "CSL", "CH"), method = "kmeans", p = 2, q = 2, corr = "pearson", nstart = 100, NCstart = TRUE)
plot_idx(re.cvi)


```

```{r CVI with realworld data, echo= TRUE}

seed = read.csv("seed.csv",header = F)
dim(seed)
seed %>% colnames()
seed %>% head(2)
seed[,ncol(seed)] %>% unique()


# check acc 

AccClust(seed, label.names = "V8",algorithm = "Kmeans", fzm = 2,
  scale = TRUE, nstart = 20,iter = 100)

# CVI
re.cvi = Hvalid(seed[,-ncol(seed)], kmax = 10, kmin = 2, indexlist = c("NCI", "DI", "DB", "DBs", "CSL", "STR"), method = "kmeans", p = 2, q = 2, corr = "pearson", nstart = 100, NCstart = TRUE)
plot_idx(re.cvi)



```



```{r MRI dataset,echo=TRUE}

# Function defined----
plotTheme <- function() {
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      linewidth = 3,
      colour = "black",
      fill = "white"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      linewidth = 2),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      colour = "gray80",
      linetype = "dotted"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(
      colour = "gray90",
      linetype = "dashed"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      #linewidth = rel(1.2),
      face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      #linewidth = rel(1.2),
      face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      #linewidth = 20,
      face = "bold",
      vjust = 1.5)
  )
}

x = "https://storage.googleapis.com/kagglesdsdata/datasets/165566/377107/no/9%20no.jpg?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=databundle-worker-v2%40kaggle-161607.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20250323%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20250323T012222Z&X-Goog-Expires=345600&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-"
download.file(x,'y.jpg', mode = 'wb')

IMG1 <- load.image("y.jpg")

IMG.dat = data.frame()

IMG.dat[1,"NAME"] = paste0("IMG",1)
IMG.dat[1,"DIM1"] = dim(IMG1)[1]
IMG.dat[1,"DIM2"] = dim(IMG1)[2]
IMG.dat[1,"DIM3"] = dim(IMG1)[3]

# convert to RGB

img.rgb = data.frame(
  x = rep(1:IMG.dat[1,"DIM2"], each = IMG.dat[1,"DIM1"]),
  y = rep(IMG.dat[1,"DIM1"]:1, IMG.dat[1,"DIM2"]),
  R = as.vector(IMG1[,,1]),
  G = as.vector(IMG1[,,2]),
  B = as.vector(IMG1[,,3]))

img.rgb

ggplot(data = img.rgb, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(colour = rgb(img.rgb[c("R", "G", "B")])) +
  labs(title = "Original Image") +
  xlab("x") +
  ylab("y") +
  plotTheme()



# check main algorithm
c = 2
c.img = kmeans(img.rgb[, c("R", "G", "B")],center = c, iter.max = 100,nstart =20)


chg.col = c("#DC0000","#26C6DA","#FFA000","#9B6BF2","#A50E82")
kColours <- rgb(c.img$centers[c.img$cluster,])
col = kColours %>% unique()
ncolor = kColours %>% unique() %>% length()

for(j in 1:ncolor){
  kColours[kColours==col[j]] =  chg.col[j]
}

# Plot for clustering algorithm
test.group = ggplot(data = img.rgb, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(colour = kColours) +
  labs(title = paste("K-Means Clustering of", c, "Colours")) +
  xlab("x") +
  ylab("y") +
  plotTheme()
test.group


# sample plot 
sample = sample(dim(img.rgb)[1],floor(0.5*dim(img.rgb)[1]),replace = FALSE)


sam.plot = img.rgb[sample,]
ggplot(data = sam.plot, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(colour = rgb(sam.plot[c("R", "G", "B")])) +
  labs(title = paste("Sample plot")) +
  xlab("x") +
  ylab("y") +
  plotTheme()


# Apply CVI

re.cvi = Wvalid(img.rgb[,c("R","G","B")], kmax = 5, kmin = 2, method = "kmeans",
  corr = "pearson", nstart = 100, sampling = 0.3, NCstart = TRUE)
plot_idx(re.cvi)




```

```{r BayesCVI, echo = TRUE}

help(package = "BayesCVI")


data = B7_data[,1:2]
plot(data)

# alpha
aalpha = c(20,20,20,5,5,5,0.5,0.5,0.5)

B.WP = B_WP.IDX(x = scale(data), kmax = 10, corr = "pearson", method = "FCM",
                fzm = 2, sampling = 1, iter = 100, nstart = 20, NCstart = TRUE,
                alpha = aalpha, mult.alpha = 1/2)

B.WP$Index %>% slice_max(WP)

B.WP$BCVI %>% slice_max(BCVI)


# plot the BCVI
pplot = plot_BCVI(B.WP)
pplot


# Apply with MRI data [9 no]

x = "https://storage.googleapis.com/kagglesdsdata/datasets/165566/377107/no/9%20no.jpg?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=databundle-worker-v2%40kaggle-161607.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20250323%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20250323T012222Z&X-Goog-Expires=345600&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-"
download.file(x,'y.jpg', mode = 'wb')

IMG1 <- load.image("y.jpg")

IMG.dat = data.frame()

IMG.dat[1,"NAME"] = paste0("IMG",1)
IMG.dat[1,"DIM1"] = dim(IMG1)[1]
IMG.dat[1,"DIM2"] = dim(IMG1)[2]
IMG.dat[1,"DIM3"] = dim(IMG1)[3]

# convert to RGB

img.rgb = data.frame(
  x = rep(1:IMG.dat[1,"DIM2"], each = IMG.dat[1,"DIM1"]),
  y = rep(IMG.dat[1,"DIM1"]:1, IMG.dat[1,"DIM2"]),
  R = as.vector(IMG1[,,1]),
  G = as.vector(IMG1[,,2]),
  B = as.vector(IMG1[,,3]))

IMG1.RGB = img.rgb

ggplot(data = img.rgb, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(colour = rgb(img.rgb[c("R", "G", "B")])) +
  labs(title = "Original Image") +
  xlab("x") +
  ylab("y") +
  plotTheme()

aalpha = c(25,25,2,2,0.5,0.5,0.5)

# use sampling in function to reduce MRI image size

WP.MRI = B_WP.IDX(x = IMG1.RGB[, c("R", "G", "B")], kmax = 8, corr = "pearson", method = "FCM",
                  fzm = 2, sampling = 0.3, iter = 100, nstart = 20, NCstart = TRUE, alpha = aalpha, mult.alpha = 1/2)


pp = plot_BCVI(WP.MRI)
pp$plot_index
pp$plot_BCVI
pp$error_bar_plot


```
